question: For each migration status, show the status and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance memory size in MB for instances involved in non-deleted, active migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.

  m.status AS status,
  AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
  MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS range_memory_mb,
  VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_memory_mb
FROM migrations AS m
JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE m.deleted = 0
